description:
You are working as a log analyst focusing on security events. Your task is to help investigate patterns of self-signed certificate creations on the system. A directory called /home/user/cert_logs/ contains log files named cert_activity_01.log and cert_activity_02.log, which are newline-delimited text files. Each log entry contains a timestamp, username, and certificate type separated by a space, e.g.: 2024-06-01T10:12:54Z alice self-signed. 1. Search for all entries where the certificate type is self-signed in both log files. 2. For each match, extract only the timestamp and username (omit the certificate type). 3. Write all matching lines to a file named /home/user/cert_logs/self_signed_summary.log. Each line should be exactly: timestamp username. 4. The entries in self_signed_summary.log must appear in chronological order (sorted by timestamp ascending). Example output (the format must exactly match this, with spaces between fields, one entry per line, ordered by timestamp): 
2024-06-01T10:12:54Z alice
2024-06-02T08:07:23Z bob
Do not remove or overwrite the source log files. Only create or overwrite /home/user/cert_logs/self_signed_summary.log. No extra text, headers, or blank lines should appear in the output file.
truth:
Before the task begins, the directory /home/user/cert_logs/ exists, and contains two files:

/home/user/cert_logs/cert_activity_01.log:
2024-06-01T10:12:54Z alice self-signed
2024-06-01T11:30:02Z carol ca-signed
2024-06-02T08:07:23Z bob self-signed

/home/user/cert_logs/cert_activity_02.log:
2024-06-03T12:04:12Z eve self-signed
2024-06-02T13:15:58Z dan ca-signed
2024-06-02T20:09:40Z frank self-signed

After successful completion, /home/user/cert_logs/self_signed_summary.log must contain, exactly:
2024-06-01T10:12:54Z alice
2024-06-02T08:07:23Z bob
2024-06-03T12:04:12Z eve
2024-06-02T20:09:40Z frank

The lines must be sorted in strict ascending order by the timestamp (the first field in ISO format).
The source log files (/home/user/cert_logs/cert_activity_01.log and /home/user/cert_logs/cert_activity_02.log) must not be modified.
